clue.text: An aromatic part of East Anglia University finally producing offensive smell

parts.note: the Fens are the low-lying marshland of East Anglia, so a fen is part of it

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word producing

parts.note: a reek is a strong, unpleasant smell

explanation.surface: A fragrant corner of a Norfolk-and-Suffolk campus that, by the end, gives off a stink.
explanation.walkthrough: East Anglia is the eastern bulge of England (Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire), home to the flat marshland called the Fens and to a University of East Anglia, which makes the surface plausible.
explanation.definitionFit: Fenugreek is a pungent herb whose seeds are used as a spice, so it is one example of an aromatic plant.

clue.text: Meal made of Ajit Agarkar's series

indicators.note: made here says the answer is formed from the letters of the following words
series signals that the answer is a run of consecutive letters across the words

explanation.surface: A dish cooked up from a run of the Indian cricketer Ajit Agarkar's bowling figures.
explanation.walkthrough: Ajit Agarkar is a former Indian Test cricketer; the answer runs from the F of 'of' through 'Ajit' to the first A of 'Agarkar'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fajita is a Mexican dish of grilled strips of meat wrapped in a tortilla, so it can serve as a meal.

clue.text: New music man with last word on advanced capital

parts.note: a disc jockey, a DJ, is a man who plays music
amen is the word that closes a prayer
A is an abbreviation for advanced, as in A level

explanation.surface: A modern musician gets the final say on a forward-looking city.
explanation.definitionFit: N'Djamena is the capital city of Chad in central Africa.

clue.text: Stagecoach rickety, case craftily purloined — you've been had!

indicators.note: rickety describes the stagecoach as shaky and falling apart, so its letters are jumbled
craftily purloined says the letters of case are slyly stolen out of the jumble, in any order

explanation.surface: A wobbly coach has had its luggage slyly stolen, and the passengers have been conned.
explanation.walkthrough: Take C, A, S, E out of the letters of STAGECOACH, wherever they fall, and rearrange the six left over.
explanation.definitionFit: Gotcha is a colloquial cry of triumph meaning I have caught or tricked you.

clue.text: Make it the same as in Parisian summer

indicators.note: in says the word for as sits inside the French word for summer

parts.note: the French for summer is ete, as a Parisian would say
qua is Latin for as, meaning in the capacity of

explanation.surface: An instruction to make something match the way it is done in a French summer.
explanation.definitionFit: To equate two things is to treat or make one equal to the other.

clue.text: One with nocturnal habits, is it Ray Davies overlooking north Loire province?

parts.note: Ray Davies was the singer of the Kinks, so he is a Kink

indicators.note: overlooking means ignoring, so the letter for north is left out of the province

parts.note: Anjou is a historic province of the Loire valley in France

explanation.surface: A question whether the night owl is Ray Davies looking down on a French region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overlooking' reads as sitting above (and KINK does sit above in this down clue), but its job is ignoring: drop the N of ANJOU to leave AJOU.
explanation.definitionFit: The kinkajou is a tree-dwelling mammal of Central and South America that feeds at night.

clue.text: Henry designated a frequent absentee from E3

definitions.text: Henry designated a frequent absentee from E3

parts.words: Henry designated a frequent absentee from E3
parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, a unit of inductance; the name of that letter is what Cockneys in London's E3 (Bow) famously drop

explanation.surface: A man called Henry is officially labelled as often missing from an East London district.
explanation.walkthrough: E3 is the London postcode for Bow, and Cockneys, born within the sound of Bow Bells, drop their h's. The henry is a unit of electrical inductance with symbol H.
explanation.definitionFit: The spelt-out name of the eighth letter of the alphabet is how H is written as a word.

clue.text: Apples delayed her acceleration through Georgian city

indicators.note: through says the letter for acceleration passes into the city's name

parts.note: Atlanta is the capital of the US state of Georgia
a is the symbol for acceleration in physics

explanation.surface: Fruit slowed a woman down while she sped across an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the huntress Atalanta lost a footrace because she stopped to pick up golden apples thrown by her suitor.

clue.text: Service in China — not one to mock it!

parts.note: to tease is to mock or make fun of

indicators.note: not one says the letter for one must be dropped

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A church service in China is no occasion for poking fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country, but read it as porcelain: a tea service made of china.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea service is the matching cups, saucers and pot used for serving the drink, often made of porcelain.

clue.text: Central American sweetie attracting Simon Le Bon and Nick Rhodes only?

parts.note: hon, short for honey, is a term of endearment like sweetie

parts.words: Simon Le Bon and Nick Rhodes only
parts.note: Le Bon and Rhodes are in the band Duran Duran, so only half its name

explanation.surface: A darling draws in a pair of 1980s pop stars on their own.
explanation.walkthrough: Simon Le Bon and Nick Rhodes are members of the 1980s pop band Duran Duran; 'only' asks for a single DURAN rather than the doubled name.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Honduras, a country in Central America, is a Honduran.

clue.text: Fighting system? It is, briefly, in the charm

indicators.note: in places the shortened form of it is inside the word for a charm

parts.note: juju is a West African charm or fetish
it is shortened is the contraction it's

explanation.surface: A question whether a fighting method is, in short, just a lucky charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Ju-jitsu is a Japanese martial art of unarmed combat, a system of fighting.

clue.text: Ace, a skilled orderly, made big acid drops

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

indicators.note: orderly here asks for the letters to be put into a new order

explanation.surface: A top hospital orderly with skill turned out large sour sweets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orderly' looks like a hospital attendant but signals the anagram of A SKILLED; 'acid drops' look like sweets but mean falls in acidity.
explanation.definitionFit: To make something more alkaline is to lower its acidity, causing a big drop in acid.

clue.text: Mean to state years

parts.note: to aver is to state firmly
an age is a long span of years

explanation.surface: Someone intends to declare their age.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean of a set of numbers is their arithmetic average.

clue.text: 1/1 hill? He'll have to take care

parts.note: 1/1 is the first of the first month, January the first, written JAN I
a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: A New Year's Day hill walker will need to watch his step.
explanation.walkthrough: A date written 1/1 is January 1st: JAN plus I, the Roman one.
explanation.definitionFit: A caretaker looks after a building, so taking care is his job.

clue.text: Gain in trust for a flourishing August 6

indicators.note: flourishing means waved about with a flourish, so the letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A boost in confidence for a thriving enterprise.
explanation.definitionFit: The Feast of the Transfiguration of Christ is celebrated by the Church on the sixth of August.

clue.text: Miffed weightlifter deprived of free training time

indicators.note: miffed means put out, so the lifter's letters are disturbed
deprived of says some letters are removed from that jumble
training applied to free says its letters may be taken out in any order

explanation.surface: An annoyed weightlifter loses out on a free workout session.
explanation.walkthrough: Take F, R, E, E out of WEIGHTLIFTER, wherever they fall, and rearrange the eight left over.
explanation.definitionFit: Twilight is the half-light at dusk, a time of day.

clue.text: It's within our power to deal with a lobster, is this

definitions.text: It's within our power to deal with a lobster, is this

indicators.note: to deal with means to handle or sort out, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A kitchen claim that a lobster is something we can handle.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: shuffling A LOBSTER gives the answer, and something we can deal with is capable of being sorted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be sorted or dealt with is within our power to handle.

clue.text: Trappings of a blacksmith? I take on prolonged fight with energy

parts.note: R stands for recipe, Latin for take, as on prescriptions
taken as written
a war is a long-drawn-out fight
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A blacksmith's gear prompts someone to take on a long, energetic battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironware is goods made of iron, the kind of things a blacksmith works with.

clue.text: English cricket team, paid up, to pursue island obsession

indicators.note: to pursue means to follow, so these letters come after the island's letter
up in a down clue says these letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a cricket team has eleven players, written XI
fee'd, from fee, means paid

explanation.surface: An English cricket side, its fees settled, chases an obsession with an island.
explanation.definitionFit: An idee fixe, from French, is an idea that dominates the mind, an obsession.

clue.text: Nether regions act presumably negative

parts.note: to infer is to act by presuming, drawing a conclusion
no is a negative answer

explanation.surface: A play put on in the underworld seems to be a pessimistic one.
explanation.definitionFit: Dante's Inferno describes Hell, the nether regions of the underworld.

clue.text: Draw attention to evidence that Her Majesty is at home?

definitions.meaning: to highlight or point out something

definitions.text: evidence that Her Majesty is at home?
definitions.meaning: the Royal Standard is raised over a royal residence when the monarch is in

explanation.surface: Pointing out a sign that the Queen is in residence.
explanation.walkthrough: At Buckingham Palace the Royal Standard flies when the sovereign is in residence.
explanation.definitionFit: To signal something is to highlight it, and a raised banner over a palace signals the monarch's presence.

clue.text: Lewd comic is on the case of Queen and ministers

parts.note: Viz is a crude British adult comic magazine

indicators.note: on the case of says the letters of is wrap around the letters for Queen

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: A smutty comic investigates the Queen and her government.
explanation.walkthrough: Viz is a British comic famous for crude humour.
explanation.definitionFit: Viziers were high officials or ministers in the Ottoman and other Muslim states.

clue.text: Cruise turning up the gay overtones part way through

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue says the letters run from bottom to top
part way through says the answer is a stretch of letters inside the phrase

explanation.surface: A cruise that turns out to have camp undertones partway along.
explanation.definitionFit: A cruise is a sea journey, and a voyage is any long trip by sea.

clue.text: Enthusiast regularly supporting legless band

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting means placed below, so these letters come after
legless says the band's name loses its foot, the final letter

parts.note: Zep, short for Led Zeppelin, is a rock band
a lot, two words, means often or regularly

explanation.surface: A fan who often holds up a drunken group of musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'legless' is British slang for very drunk, but here it cuts the bottom letter off ZEP in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A zealot is a fanatical supporter of a cause, an extreme enthusiast.

clue.text: Restrains great bat

definitions.meaning: calms or steadies someone, makes them serious
Sir Garfield, the West Indian all-rounder, was one of cricket's great batsmen

explanation.definitionFit: The word means calms down, and is also the surname of Sir Garfield, one of cricket's finest batsmen.

clue.text: Very upset, I will take notice when mediating

indicators.note: mediating means standing between, so the take-and-notice letters sit between the other two

an ad is a notice, as in a newspaper

explanation.surface: Someone in a distressed state promises to heed things while acting as a go-between.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in a bad way is in a poor or distressed condition, much upset.

clue.text: To date today's top compiler (no introduction needed), call me to fix!

indicators.note: no introduction needed says the word call loses its opening letter
top asks for the first letter of today's

parts.note: a setter often refers to himself as I, the compiler of the puzzle

explanation.surface: Today's best setter, a household name, asks to be phoned to sort things out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes something unsurpassed in all of history up to now, i.e. to date.

clue.text: Indian home fillings for jacket potato, meat pies and cabinet pudding, it's rumoured

indicators.note: it's rumoured says the letters must be heard spoken rather than read
fillings means the letters at the centre of each dish's name

explanation.surface: Three British comfort foods offer the fillings for a native dwelling.
explanation.walkthrough: JACKET POTATO, MEAT PIES and CABINET PUDDING each have T and P as their two central letters; spoken, T-P gives the answer. Cabinet pudding is an old British steamed pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: A tepee is a conical tent of the North American Plains peoples, once called Indians.

clue.text: Feature of upstanding characters before tax once claiming no time for return

parts.note: ere is an old word for before

indicators.note: claiming means taking in, so the old tax holds the other letters

parts.note: cess was a former local tax

indicators.note: for return says the letters are turned back to front

explanation.surface: Honest people, who once paid their taxes promptly, are known for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upstanding' suggests honesty but means standing upright, so the characters are letters like I and L that stand erect.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing straight up is a feature of upright characters or letters.
